item.title: Proof of Human (YC S23) Is Hiring a Member of Technical Staff
item.description:
📝 continuous human verification without CAPTCHAs or user friction Proof of Human provides frictionless, continual human verification. Proof of Human is a research and deployment company building the proof-of-human layer in digital identity. Proof of Human seeks to produce high-impact research and to productize this research in bot detection, fraud prevention, and continuous authentication.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/proof-of-human/jobs/ZTZHEbb-member-of-technical-staff

item.title: Seeing beyond BMI: Estimating cardiometabolic risk with smartphone imagery
item.description:
📝 Overview of the body composition pipeline and insulin resistance classification. Body composition metrics are first estimated from the pretrained PhotoScan model, and the body composition features, combined with user demographics are used for insulin resistance classification. How PhotoScan worksPhotoScan bypasses the clinical measurements by extracting geometric body information directly from smartphone images.
🔗 Read more: https://research.google/blog/seeing-beyond-bmi-estimating-cardiometabolic-risk-with-smartphone-imagery/

item.title: Australia passes law to levy tech giants that fail to pay for local news
Risk Engineering
item.description:
📝 Risk Engineering This site provides e-learning courseware and training materials (slides, lecture notes, problem sets, Python notebooks…) on risk engineering, loss prevention and safety management. Risk engineering is the application of engineering skills and methodologies to the management of risk. It involves hazard identification, risk analysis, risk evaluation and risk treatment.
🔗 Read more: https://risk-engineering.org/
